security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI writes a new value to mpmpdeleg.pmpnum to reallocate entries between PMP and SPMP without first storing and clearing the affected PMP/SPMP configuration registers. When pmpnum is changed, the configuration bits (pmpcfg/spmpcfg) and address registers (pmpaddr/spmpaddr) of the reallocated entries inherit stale values from their previous role, which may grant S-mode unintended memory access permissions.
security_spec.summary: OpenSBI must store-and-clear affected PMP/SPMP config registers before writing mpmpdeleg.pmpnum, or stale inherited configs can grant S-mode access to M-mode-only physical memory

findings.finding: OpenSBI does not implement the SPMP (S-mode Physical Memory Protection) extension. The mpmpdeleg CSR, pmpnum field, miselect/mireg/mireg2 indirect-access registers, sspmpswitch, and all SPMP-related CSR encodings (spmpcfg, spmpaddr) have zero references in OpenSBI C source, headers, or assembly files. The spec violation condition — writing mpmpdeleg.pmpnum to reallocate entries between PMP and SPMP without first storing+clearing affected configuration registers — cannot be analyzed against code that does not exist. This is a definitive 'not_implemented': the target firmware source contains no logic for the described RISC-V component.
findings.snippet: (no code — SPMP extension is absent from the OpenSBI codebase)
